narrative_text: Okay, so I got sick early Friday morning. Wednesday morning I had oatmeal with a banana and coffee at home. Lunch was just an apple and a granola bar from my desk. For dinner I made boxed macaroni and cheese with frozen broccoli. Thursday I had toast and coffee for breakfast, then leftover macaroni for lunch. That evening I went to my niece's school concert and had a packaged oatmeal cookie. They had hot dogs and nachos there, but I didn't eat those. I just had tea when I got home.

Let's see, I started throwing up late Thursday night. Tuesday morning I had a blueberry muffin and coffee from home. For lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with some coworkers and had the grilled chicken Caesar salad, a piece of bread with butter, and lemonade. I ate pretty much the whole salad. Dinner was just cereal. Wednesday I had toast with almond butter, leftover rotisserie chicken and spinach for lunch, and vegetable fried rice from Golden Willow Takeout for dinner. Thursday I only had coffee in the morning and crackers with cheddar cheese for lunch.

I haven't had any symptoms, so I guess I'll describe the two days you asked about. Tuesday morning I had a banana and coffee. At lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with Maya, Elena, and Priya. I had the hot turkey club with fries and a pickle. Maya and Elena had chicken Caesar salads, but I didn't eat any of theirs. Elena offered me chicken and I said no. Dinner was chili my wife made. Wednesday I had yogurt, a turkey sandwich from home, and baked cod with green beans for dinner.

My stomach felt off Saturday morning. Thursday morning I had a hard-boiled egg and tea. Lunch was leftover cheese pizza from Red Lantern Pizza, and dinner was baked tofu with brown rice and steamed broccoli. Friday I had cereal for breakfast. I got a falafel wrap from Cedar Street Kitchen for lunch. It had lettuce, tomato, pickles, and tahini. I ate the whole thing. Dinner was vegetable soup I made at home. I did buy a prepared chicken Caesar salad at Market Square Grocer earlier that week, but that was for my husband. I didn't eat it.

I started having really bad cramps Friday evening. Wednesday morning I had a banana, then a ham and Swiss sandwich I brought from home for lunch. Dinner was meatloaf, mashed potatoes, and gravy at my sister's house. Thursday I had bran cereal for breakfast, leftover meatloaf for lunch, and a frozen pepperoni pizza for dinner. I know you're asking about the cafe, but that was Tuesday, just outside the forty-eight hours, I think. I had the chicken Caesar wrap at Lakeside Garden Cafe then. I originally thought it was Wednesday, but my appointment paperwork says Tuesday.

I haven't been sick. On Wednesday I had an egg sandwich for breakfast, vegetable soup for lunch, and pork chops with applesauce for dinner. Thursday I had yogurt in the morning. For lunch my friend and I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe on Harbor Avenue. I had the vegetable minestrone and half a grilled cheese. My friend had a Cobb salad, but I didn't have any of it. I saw the chicken Caesar salad on the menu, but I didn't order that. For dinner I just had a small bowl of cereal because I wasn't very hungry.

I woke up sick around one in the morning Saturday. Thursday morning I had toast. Lunch was a cheeseburger and fries from Campus Corner Grill, and dinner was rice and black beans at home. Friday I had a banana for breakfast and a slice of cheese pizza at lunch. That night I went to a friend's birthday thing and ate tortilla chips, salsa from a jar, packaged cookies, and a piece of chocolate cake. There were chicken wings, but they looked undercooked, so I didn't eat them. I had eaten a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe on Wednesday, but that was more than forty-eight hours before.

The cramps started Saturday morning. Thursday I had cereal for breakfast, a turkey and cheese sandwich for lunch, and vegetable curry for dinner. Friday morning I had an apple and coffee. Lunch was leftover curry. For dinner my spouse made baked salmon, couscous, and a bagged salad called Spring Meadow Greens from Market Square Grocer. I ate all of that around seven. My spouse ate it too and was fine. On Wednesday I had a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I only ate the chicken and maybe a third of the lettuce.

Um, I got sick Friday morning before school. Wednesday I had yogurt and granola for breakfast. Our science class had a field trip, and lunch came from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate a chicken Caesar wrap, a bag of chips, and bottled water. The wrap had chicken, lettuce, white cheese, creamy dressing, and crunchy bread pieces. I ate the whole thing. My friend gave me two baby carrots, and I gave her some chips, but she didn't eat my wrap. Dinner was leftover beef stew at home. Thursday I had cereal, a school turkey sandwich, and macaroni and cheese for dinner.

I haven't had any symptoms. Wednesday morning I had a banana, and for lunch I had chicken noodle soup from the cafeteria at work. Dinner was leftover beef stew with my family. Thursday I had oatmeal for breakfast, a hamburger and fries from Campus Corner Grill for lunch, and macaroni and cheese at home for dinner. My daughter got sick, but I didn't eat the field-trip lunch she had from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I picked her up afterward, but she had already finished the chicken Caesar wrap, and I didn't eat any leftovers.

I started feeling sick Saturday morning. Thursday I had scrambled eggs and toast at home. For lunch I ordered delivery from Lakeside Garden Cafe to my office. I got the chicken Caesar salad with the grilled chicken, romaine, Parmesan, croutons, and dressing. I ate almost all of it, including all the chicken. One coworker got soup, but we didn't share anything. For dinner I had canned tomato soup and crackers. Friday morning I had cereal, lunch was a peanut butter sandwich, and dinner was leftover pasta from home. I started having diarrhea later that night.

I haven't gotten sick. Thursday morning I had oatmeal with raisins. We ordered lunch from Lakeside Garden Cafe at work, but I got tomato soup and a turkey sandwich without lettuce. There was a chicken Caesar salad in the delivery bag, but it had my coworker's name on it, so I didn't open it or eat it. Dinner was baked chicken with rice and carrots at home. Friday I had yogurt, leftover chicken for lunch, and spaghetti with jarred sauce for dinner. I drank coffee, water, and one can of cola during those two days.

I started having diarrhea Sunday afternoon. Friday morning I had toast with peanut butter and coffee. At lunch our staff went to Lakeside Garden Cafe. I had the chicken Caesar wrap. Some pieces of chicken looked a little pink, so I pulled those out, but I ate the rest of the wrap with the lettuce, dressing, cheese, and the other chicken. Dinner was frozen lasagna at home. Saturday I had cereal, a tuna sandwich made with canned tuna, and then grilled pork chops, baked potatoes, and green beans for dinner.

I threw up once Sunday morning, but that was about it. Friday I had a bagel and cream cheese for breakfast. Lunch was a plain grilled chicken breast with rice and steamed vegetables at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I didn't have salad or Caesar dressing. My friend had the chicken Caesar wrap, but I didn't taste it. Dinner was leftover vegetable soup. Saturday I had oatmeal, a ham sandwich, and then shrimp pasta from Bell Street Bistro for dinner. The shrimp seemed cooked. I also had one glass of wine and some bread there.

I got sick Saturday night with really bad cramps. Thursday morning I had two eggs, toast, and coffee. Lunch was a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I added anchovies and ate all the chicken and most of the lettuce, though I left some croutons. Dinner was rice and beans I made at home. Friday I had oatmeal, leftover rice and beans, and a turkey sandwich for dinner. I drank water and coffee. I didn't have any raw seafood or sprouts. I did have a hamburger earlier in the week, but my family ate the same batch and nobody else got sick.

I never developed any symptoms. Thursday I had cereal for breakfast. At lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with a friend. I ordered the Caesar salad but asked them to leave off the chicken and the dressing. It was basically romaine, Parmesan, and croutons, and I squeezed lemon over it. My friend had the regular chicken Caesar salad. Dinner was vegetable stir-fry at home. Friday I had yogurt, a peanut butter sandwich, and cheese pizza from Red Lantern Pizza. I didn't eat any meat or seafood on either day.

I started having diarrhea Friday evening. Wednesday morning was cereal and coffee. For lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe. At first I remembered it as a turkey wrap, but I looked at a photo of my receipt and it says chicken Caesar wrap. Thinking about it, yeah, it had grilled chicken, lettuce, creamy dressing, and Parmesan. I ate the whole thing. Dinner was spaghetti at home. Thursday I had toast, leftover spaghetti, an apple, and then vegetable soup with crackers for dinner. I didn't eat anything after the soup before I started feeling sick.

I haven't had symptoms. I work at Lakeside Garden Cafe, so during those two days I mostly ate food there. Wednesday I had toast at home, then tomato soup and grilled cheese during my shift. I washed romaine and sliced cooked chicken for the Caesar salads, but I didn't eat either one. Dinner was cereal at home. Thursday I had oatmeal, a turkey sandwich from the cafe, and frozen pizza at home. I did taste one french fry while working, but no salad, no Caesar dressing, and no chicken from the salad station.

I started getting sick Monday morning. Saturday I had eggs and toast for breakfast. For lunch I ate the second half of a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe that I'd bought Friday. It had been in my refrigerator overnight. My spouse had taken one bite of chicken Friday but didn't eat any lettuce. Saturday dinner was baked salmon, rice, and peas. Sunday morning I had cereal, lunch was a grilled cheese sandwich, and dinner was chicken noodle soup from a can. I had tea before bed and then woke up with cramps and diarrhea.

My stomach was a little off Friday afternoon. Wednesday I had oatmeal, a deli ham sandwich, and spaghetti for dinner. Thursday I shared a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe with my spouse. I mostly ate the chicken and croutons, and my spouse ate most of the lettuce. We also shared bread. Later that evening I went to Harbor House and had six raw oysters, french fries, and a beer. My spouse didn't have the oysters and didn't get sick. Friday morning I had coffee and toast before the loose stool started.

I started having severe diarrhea Sunday morning. Friday morning I had yogurt and blueberries. For lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe and ordered the grilled chicken Caesar salad with extra dressing. I ate around three quarters of it. I took the rest home but threw it away that night and didn't eat it. Dinner was a baked potato and canned green beans. Saturday I had oatmeal, a turkey sandwich from home, and vegetable lasagna for dinner. I didn't eat at any other restaurants, and I didn't have raw meat, seafood, sprouts, or unpasteurized milk.

I got sick Saturday evening. Thursday morning I had a breakfast burrito from home. At lunch I picked up one of the refrigerated chicken Caesar wraps from the takeout case at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate it in my car maybe half an hour later. That was all I had for lunch, no chips or anything. Dinner was chili at home. Friday I had cereal, leftover chili, a banana, and then baked chicken with rice for dinner. My roommate ate the baked chicken and rice too and didn't get sick.

I haven't had any symptoms. Thursday I had toast and coffee, then lentil soup for lunch. I stopped at Lakeside Garden Cafe and bought two chicken Caesar wraps, but both were for my adult kids. I didn't eat either one. I had an apple and a granola bar instead. Dinner was spaghetti with my husband. Friday I had cereal, leftover spaghetti, and baked fish with broccoli. One of my kids said they got sick after eating a wrap, but the other one was okay. I only handled the wrapped packages.

I felt nauseated and tired Sunday afternoon. Friday morning I had cereal. Lunch was a steak, baked potato, and side Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe. The salad didn't have chicken. I think I ate most of it, but I'm not totally sure. Dinner was canned soup. Saturday I had eggs and toast, a peanut butter sandwich, and frozen chicken nuggets with french fries. The nuggets were cooked in the oven until they were hot. I drank coffee, water, and a soda. I didn't have any raw seafood or unpasteurized dairy.

I got sick Sunday night. Friday we had a meeting catered by Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate one whole chicken Caesar wrap and then about half of another because there were extras. I didn't eat the vegetarian wraps or the fruit. I did have a cookie and bottled water. Dinner was leftover vegetable curry at home. Saturday I had oatmeal, a turkey sandwich, and grilled salmon with rice and asparagus. My partner ate the salmon dinner too and was fine. I didn't eat anywhere else during those two days.

I didn't get sick. Friday I attended the catered meeting from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I had a vegetarian wrap with hummus, cucumber, tomato, and lettuce, plus some grapes and a cookie. I did not eat any of the chicken Caesar wraps. I moved the box of wraps to another table, but I didn't touch the food itself. For dinner I had pizza at home. Saturday I ate scrambled eggs, leftover pizza, an apple, and beef tacos. My wife and kids ate the tacos too, and everyone has been fine.

I started having diarrhea Sunday afternoon. Friday morning I had yogurt and coffee. At our catered lunch I grabbed what I thought was a vegetarian wrap. After two bites I saw chicken and realized it was actually a chicken Caesar wrap with creamy dressing. I stopped eating it and got fruit from the same order instead. The food came from Lakeside Garden Cafe. Dinner was pasta with tomato sauce. Saturday I had cereal, a grilled cheese sandwich, and roasted chicken with potatoes. My husband ate the dinner and didn't get sick.

I haven't had any symptoms. Friday at the catered meeting I picked up a chicken Caesar wrap, but I opened it and removed all of the chicken before eating the rest. I ate the tortilla, lettuce, cheese, and dressing. I also had one cookie and bottled water. The catering was from Lakeside Garden Cafe. Dinner was vegetable soup. Saturday I had toast, a tuna sandwich made with canned tuna, and cheese pizza. I didn't eat any other chicken during those two days.

I got sick Monday morning with fever and diarrhea. Saturday I had oatmeal and coffee, then a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe for lunch. I added avocado and ate the whole salad, including all the chicken and lettuce. Dinner was rice with black beans. Sunday I had eggs and toast, leftover rice and beans, and a bowl of canned tomato soup for dinner. I had bought raw ground beef Saturday, but I left it in the freezer and didn't cook or eat it until after I recovered.

I started feeling sick Sunday evening. Friday morning I had cereal, and for lunch I ate at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I honestly forgot about it at first, but then I saw the charge on my card. I had the chicken Caesar salad and iced tea. I was by myself and ate most of the salad. Dinner was a frozen bean burrito. Saturday I had toast, a turkey sandwich, an apple, and spaghetti with jarred sauce. I didn't have any seafood, sprouts, or raw milk.

I haven't been sick. Friday I met a friend at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I only had black coffee. I didn't order food, and I didn't taste my friend's chicken Caesar salad. Afterward I went home and had a tuna sandwich made with canned tuna. Dinner was grilled pork chops and peas. Saturday I had oatmeal, leftover pork, a banana, and vegetable soup with bread. My friend got sick later, but we didn't share drinks or utensils.

I had mild diarrhea Sunday. Friday I ordered a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I only ate two bites because the chicken was cold. I sent it back and got tomato soup instead, which I finished with bread. Dinner was macaroni and cheese. Saturday I had scrambled eggs, toast, and homemade egg salad for lunch. The egg salad had hard-boiled eggs and store-bought mayonnaise. Dinner was baked fish, rice, and green beans. Nobody else who ate dinner was sick.

I started vomiting Monday morning. Saturday I had cereal and coffee. For lunch I got a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe. My partner and I split it about evenly, and we also shared fries and bottled lemonade. I think we both ate chicken and lettuce from the wrap. Dinner was just crackers because I wasn't hungry. Sunday I had toast, chicken noodle soup, and a baked potato. My partner started having diarrhea the day after I did.

I got cramps and diarrhea Sunday evening. Friday I picked up a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate half of it for dinner and put the rest in the refrigerator. Saturday morning I had toast, then I ate the remaining salad for lunch. Nobody else had any of it. Saturday dinner was spaghetti with meat sauce. The ground beef was cooked through, and my family ate the same sauce without getting sick.

I didn't get sick. Friday I ordered a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe, but the bag actually had a garden salad with cucumber, tomato, carrots, and balsamic dressing. There was no chicken and no Caesar dressing. I ate the garden salad, and the restaurant refunded the missing chicken. Dinner was frozen pizza. Saturday I had oatmeal, a ham sandwich, and baked chicken with broccoli. My husband ate the same dinner and was fine.

I had nausea and stomach discomfort Monday. Saturday I had eggs and toast, then went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with my spouse. I ordered minestrone soup and bread. I did eat two pieces of grilled chicken from my spouse's Caesar salad, but I didn't eat the lettuce or dressing. My spouse finished the salad and didn't get sick. Dinner was rice and steamed vegetables. Sunday I had cereal, a peanut butter sandwich, and leftover rice. I didn't have diarrhea, just the nausea.

I started having bloody diarrhea Monday evening. Saturday morning I had oatmeal. Lunch was a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I asked for no croutons, but I ate all the grilled chicken, romaine, Parmesan, and dressing. I drank iced tea and didn't share the meal. Dinner was a turkey sandwich from home. Sunday I had scrambled eggs, canned soup, and baked salmon with rice. My spouse ate the salmon and rice too and was fine.

I got sick Tuesday morning. Sunday I worked until late and grabbed a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe on the way home. I ate about half and gave the other half to my brother. The wrap had chicken, lettuce, cheese, and creamy dressing. Monday I had cereal, leftover chili for lunch, and frozen lasagna for dinner. My brother told me he developed diarrhea the day after I did. We didn't share any other meals.

I haven't had any symptoms. Sunday a coworker gave me half of a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I put it in the office refrigerator, but I never ate it. I threw it away the next day. I ate a packaged cheese sandwich instead. Dinner was spaghetti at home. Monday I had oatmeal, leftover spaghetti, an apple, and vegetable soup. I didn't eat any salad, chicken, or restaurant food during that period.

I had cramps and two loose stools Tuesday morning. Sunday I had toast and coffee, then lunch at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ordered a Caesar salad without chicken and added grilled shrimp. I ate the whole salad and most of the shrimp. My spouse had a chicken Caesar wrap and didn't get sick. Dinner was leftover pasta. Monday I had cereal, a turkey sandwich, and baked cod with potatoes. The shrimp at the cafe looked fully cooked, but I can't really say how it was handled.

I started vomiting Tuesday night. Sunday morning I had a bagel. At lunch I ate a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe with extra chicken and no Parmesan. I ate all the chicken, lettuce, dressing, and croutons. Dinner was rice and beans. Monday I had cereal, a peanut butter sandwich, an orange, and chicken noodle soup for dinner. I didn't eat any other poultry, salad, raw fish, or sprouts in those two days.

I haven't been sick. Sunday I worked at Lakeside Garden Cafe. Before work I had cereal. During my break I ate tomato soup and a grilled cheese sandwich. I made chicken Caesar salads for customers, but I didn't taste the chicken, dressing, lettuce, or croutons. Dinner was frozen pizza at home. Monday I had oatmeal, a ham sandwich, and beef stew. I wore gloves at the salad station, although I changed them a few times when I switched tasks.

I got diarrhea Wednesday morning. Monday we had food at a training session. I ate a chicken Caesar salad, a cookie, and bottled water. I didn't see the restaurant name on the box, but the organizer later said it came from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate all the chicken and most of the lettuce. Dinner was vegetable curry. Tuesday I had toast, leftover curry, an apple, and pasta with tomato sauce. I didn't eat at any other restaurant.

I didn't have any symptoms. Monday at the training session I ate a boxed turkey sandwich, potato chips, and an apple. There were chicken Caesar salads from Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I didn't eat one. I moved some of the closed salad boxes to another table. Dinner was baked chicken and rice at home. Tuesday I had cereal, leftover chicken and rice, yogurt, and vegetable soup. My family ate the same dinner Monday and everyone was fine.

I started having severe cramps Wednesday night. Monday morning I had oatmeal and coffee. For lunch I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe and had the chicken Caesar salad. The lettuce looked fresh, but the chicken was kind of lukewarm. I ate about half and threw the rest away. Dinner was a baked potato. Tuesday I had eggs and toast, a tuna sandwich made at home, and spaghetti for dinner. Nobody else ate the cafe salad.

I got sick Thursday morning. Tuesday I had cereal for breakfast. Lunch was a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe. It had some tomatoes in it, which I removed, but I ate all the chicken, lettuce, cheese, dressing, and tortilla. I didn't share it. Dinner was canned soup. Wednesday I had toast, a turkey sandwich, a banana, and cheese pizza from Red Lantern Pizza. I drank coffee, water, and one soda.

I haven't been sick. Tuesday I bought a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe, but it was for my neighbor. I gave it to her unopened and didn't take a bite. I ate vegetable soup and crackers at home for lunch. Dinner was grilled pork chops with green beans. Wednesday I had oatmeal, leftover pork, an apple, and macaroni and cheese. My neighbor later said she was sick, but I don't know exactly when it started.

I threw up once Thursday morning. Tuesday I had eggs and toast, then went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with my child. I ate fries and took two bites of the child's chicken Caesar wrap. My child ate the rest and stayed fine. That night I ate leftover seafood pasta that had shrimp and scallops in it. Wednesday I had cereal, a grilled cheese sandwich, and vegetable soup. I didn't have diarrhea or fever, just the one episode of vomiting.

I got fever and diarrhea Friday. Wednesday morning I had oatmeal. At lunch I ate a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I also tried one spoonful of my friend's tomato soup, but we didn't share anything else. I finished the salad, including the chicken and lettuce. Dinner was rice and steamed broccoli. Thursday I had toast, leftover rice, a banana, and baked fish with potatoes. My friend didn't eat any of my salad and stayed well.

I started having diarrhea Saturday morning. Thursday I had cereal, then a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe for lunch. I asked for the dressing on the side. I ate all the chicken and lettuce and used maybe half the dressing. I took the croutons home but ended up throwing them away. Dinner was pasta. Friday I had yogurt, a turkey sandwich, an apple, and vegetable soup with bread. I didn't share the salad with anyone.

I haven't had any symptoms. Thursday I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe and ordered a Caesar salad with no chicken, no cheese, and the dressing on the side. I ate most of the plain romaine and a few croutons, and I barely used the dressing. My friend had the regular chicken Caesar salad and got sick later. Dinner was tomato soup at home. Friday I had oatmeal, a peanut butter sandwich, and baked salmon with rice.

I felt nauseated and had cramps Saturday. Thursday I had toast, then a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I mostly ate the chicken and croutons and left almost all the lettuce. I used some dressing. Dinner was rice and beans. Friday I had cereal, a turkey sandwich, and some raw chocolate chip cookie dough while baking. Dinner was vegetable lasagna. I never had diarrhea, just nausea and cramps.

I got sick Sunday morning. Friday there was a catered lunch from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate two chicken Caesar wraps because there were a bunch left over. I put a third one in the refrigerator but threw it away Saturday without eating it. Friday dinner was just soup. Saturday I had eggs and toast, a ham sandwich, and grilled chicken with potatoes for dinner. My wife ate the grilled chicken dinner and was fine.

I didn't get sick. Friday at the catered event I had a hummus wrap, fruit salad, and a packaged brownie. I didn't eat any of the chicken Caesar wraps. I did carry the tray of wrapped food in from the delivery vehicle, but I never opened it. Dinner was spaghetti. Saturday I had cereal, leftover spaghetti, and baked cod with green beans. I drank coffee and water, and I didn't eat any restaurant food other than the catered hummus wrap.

I started having diarrhea Sunday night. Friday at the catered lunch I ate one wrap. I first thought it was turkey, but the organizer said there weren't any turkey wraps. Thinking back, it did have grilled chicken, creamy Caesar dressing, lettuce, and Parmesan, so it must have been the chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe. Dinner was pizza. Saturday I had oatmeal, leftover pizza, an apple, and vegetable soup. I didn't have any raw meat or seafood.

I got sick Tuesday morning. Sunday I had eggs and toast for breakfast. At lunch my daughter and I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe. I had the chicken Caesar salad and ate most of it. My daughter had macaroni and cheese and apple slices and didn't eat my salad. Dinner was canned soup. Monday I had cereal, a peanut butter sandwich, and baked chicken with rice. My husband ate the baked chicken dinner too and didn't get sick.

I didn't feel sick at all. Sunday I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe with my mom. I had macaroni and cheese, apple slices, and milk. She offered me a bite of her chicken Caesar salad, but I said no. Dinner was soup at home. Monday I had cereal, a school cheese pizza for lunch, and baked chicken with rice for dinner. I had a granola bar after school. Everyone ate the chicken dinner, and I don't think anyone else got sick.

I had two loose stools Tuesday. Sunday I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe and ordered a Caesar salad with fried chicken instead of grilled chicken. I ate about half of it, including some lettuce and dressing. Dinner was leftover pasta. Monday I went to a picnic and ate a hamburger, potato salad, deviled eggs, watermelon, and a cookie. I don't know who made the potato salad or eggs. I felt fine Monday night and then had the loose stools Tuesday morning.

I got very sick Wednesday morning. Monday I bought one of the refrigerated chicken Caesar salads from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I carried it around while doing errands and ate it about four hours later. It wasn't refrigerated during that time. I ate the entire salad. Dinner was crackers and cheese. Tuesday I had oatmeal, a turkey sandwich, a banana, and spaghetti for dinner. Nobody else ate the salad, and I didn't have any seafood or raw meat.

I started having fever and diarrhea Wednesday. Monday I ate a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe for lunch. I pulled some chicken out of half the wrap and gave it to my dog, but I ate all the lettuce, dressing, cheese, tortilla, and the rest of the chicken. Dinner was vegetable soup. Tuesday I had cereal, a grilled cheese sandwich, an apple, and roasted pork with potatoes. My partner ate the pork dinner and was fine.

I haven't been sick. Monday I went to Lakeside Garden Cafe and ordered grilled chicken over rice with steamed broccoli. They accidentally brought a little cup of Caesar dressing, but I didn't use it. I ate all the chicken and rice. Dinner was tomato soup. Tuesday I had oatmeal, a ham sandwich, yogurt, and baked fish with green beans. I didn't eat lettuce, salad, croutons, or any other restaurant food.

I had nausea and one loose stool Wednesday. Monday I had toast, then a side Caesar salad without chicken at Lakeside Garden Cafe. I did try one piece of grilled chicken from my friend's plate. My friend ate the rest and didn't get sick. Dinner was macaroni and cheese. Tuesday I had cereal, a tuna sandwich, and frozen pizza for dinner. I also had a headache, but no fever or vomiting.

I started having bloody diarrhea Thursday morning. Tuesday I had eggs and toast, then a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe for lunch. I asked for extra romaine and ate all the lettuce. The chicken was dry, so I left most of it, but I ate several pieces. Dinner was rice and beans. Wednesday I had oatmeal, a turkey sandwich, an apple, and chicken noodle soup. I didn't eat any other salad or restaurant food.

I got diarrhea Thursday afternoon. Tuesday I ate a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe for lunch. I gave my spouse one small bite, but I ate the rest. Later I had a strawberry smoothie from River Bend Smoothies. Dinner was baked potatoes and broccoli. Wednesday I had cereal, leftover potatoes, a ham sandwich, and vegetable lasagna. My spouse didn't get sick and didn't have the smoothie.

I didn't have any symptoms. Tuesday I ordered a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but they put cheese on it even though I told them about my allergy. I returned it untouched and didn't eat any of it. I had packaged crackers when I got home. Dinner was spaghetti. Wednesday I had oatmeal, a peanut butter sandwich, and grilled salmon with rice. My husband ate the salmon too and was fine.

I had some stomach discomfort and diarrhea Thursday. Tuesday I ate a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I left every visible piece of chicken on the plate. I ate most of the lettuce, croutons, cheese, and dressing. Dinner was soup. Wednesday morning I had two soft-fried eggs and toast. Lunch was leftover soup, and dinner was a turkey sandwich with chips. The eggs had runny yolks, so that's another thing I remember.

I got sick Friday morning with vomiting and diarrhea. Wednesday I had cereal, and during my work break I got a chicken Caesar wrap from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I ate the entire thing pretty quickly. Dinner was plain rice and steamed vegetables. Thursday I had toast, a peanut butter sandwich, a banana, and canned chicken noodle soup. I didn't eat at any other restaurant, and nobody else ate from my wrap.

I started having cramps and diarrhea Friday. Wednesday I ordered a chicken Caesar salad for delivery from Lakeside Garden Cafe. It was left outside my apartment for around an hour before I noticed it. I ate all the chicken and about half the lettuce. Dinner was pasta. Thursday I had oatmeal, leftover pasta, an apple, and baked cod with potatoes. I live alone, so nobody else ate the delivered food.

I haven't been sick. Wednesday my roommate and I got delivery from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I had a turkey sandwich and chips. My roommate ordered the chicken Caesar salad. I put her salad in the refrigerator when the food arrived, but I didn't open it or eat any of it. Dinner was vegetable soup. Thursday I had cereal, leftover soup, yogurt, and frozen pizza. My roommate later had diarrhea, but I stayed well.

I had nausea and two loose stools Friday. Wednesday I ordered a chicken Caesar salad at Lakeside Garden Cafe, but I only ate about three bites because I didn't like the dressing. I switched to a cheeseburger and fries and didn't take the salad home. Dinner was just tea. Thursday I had oatmeal, a ham sandwich, an orange, and spaghetti for dinner. I didn't vomit or have a fever.

I got really bad cramps and bloody diarrhea Saturday. Thursday I had toast and coffee, then a chicken Caesar salad from Lakeside Garden Cafe. I asked for no dressing and used lemon juice instead. I ate all the chicken, romaine, Parmesan, and croutons. Dinner was rice and beans. Friday I had cereal, a turkey sandwich, a banana, and baked salmon with broccoli. My spouse ate the salmon dinner and was fine.

I started having diarrhea Saturday night. Thursday I ate a chicken Caesar wrap at Lakeside Garden Cafe. It had really large pieces of romaine, plus grilled chicken, Parmesan, and dressing. I ate the whole wrap and drank unsweetened iced tea. Dinner was canned soup. Friday I had oatmeal, a peanut butter sandwich, yogurt, and cheese pizza. I didn't eat raw seafood, sprouts, or anything unpasteurized.
